title: Which Detective Are You?
description: Every great mystery needs a great mind. When the case lands on your desk, how do you crack it?

answers.text: Reconstruct their morning in ninety seconds. It's in the car.
Ask the staff so nicely they check the kitchen twice
Pull up the tracking app you made everyone install
Text it. Someone always picks up.

questions.text: A friend's phone goes missing at brunch. You:

answers.text: Logic grids, timed
People. People are the puzzle.
Anything requiring three open books
Spot-the-difference. You're unbeatable.
You'd already worked out it was coming
People simply tell you things. Everything.
You know the person who knows the person
You were quietly there when it happened
Anywhere with good light and zero interruptions
A library corner you've claimed for years
A diner booth where the regulars know you
A park bench with a view of everything
'The Diplomat'
'The Professor'
'The Fixer'
'The Quiet One Who Misses Nothing'

questions.text: Your friends' nickname energy for you:

answers.text: Predict the entire menu from the signage alone
Befriend the owner by week two
Read forty reviews before setting foot inside
Already know the chef from their last place

questions.text: A new restaurant opens nearby. You:

answers.text: Three words that unlock the whole thing later
Notes about people: birthdays, kids' names, favorite teams
Color-coded, indexed, cross-referenced
Mostly mental. All accurate.

questions.text: Someone's story doesn't add up. You:

answers.text: Point out the contradiction immediately, with timeline
Draw out the truth so gently they thank you for it
Quietly check with your sources first
Say nothing. Watch. The truth surfaces.
Speed chess
Genealogy — you've traced back nine generations
Flea market treasure hunting
Birdwatching, competitively (with yourself)
Reuniting old friends who lost touch
Solving a family history mystery in the archives
Finding the best-kept secret spot in town
Mapping the neighborhood cat's secret second family

results.description: Your interrogation method is being genuinely delightful. People open up to you within minutes, and you solve cases over coffee that others couldn't crack in weeks.
Lightning logic and a flair for the reveal. You see the whole picture from three details and you're rarely wrong — the dramatic explanation is your favorite part.
Patient, quiet, and utterly unmissable-proof. You blend into the background, catch everything, and by the time others start looking, you already know.
The archives are your crime scene. Meticulous research, deep knowledge, and cross-referenced facts crack your cases — the truth is always in the records.
Your network is your superpower. You know everyone, owe nobody, and can find anything in town with three phone calls and a handshake.
